messages:
maria: quick heads-up — planning to nudge the `enable_new_defaults` flag from OFF -> gradual ON at 11:30 PT today. low-risk customers only for first 30m. 
chris: noted. who is the owner for the flip? and who does the smoke?
maria: i'll flip the toggle and monitor dashboards. @devon can you run the smoke checklist and keep an eye on latency? 
devon: i can run smoke. will execute these checks post-flip: 
```
1) /smoke/run -k default-city
2) curl -sS https://api.redwood.dev/health | jq .status
3) quick traffic gen to sample tenant A,B,C (prefab script)
```
sam: i'll stand by for rollback if anything looks off. do we have the rollback command handy?
maria: rollback is `flagsctl set enable_new_defaults false --env prod` — i've prepped a rollback playbook in #eng-runbooks, link: https://wiki.redwood.dev/rollbacks/enable_new_defaults
chris: thumbs on metrics to watch:  p50/p95 latency, errors 5xx rate, token throughput per model. set alert window to 5m for first 30m.
devon: running smoke script on my laptop now, will report back asap. sam — can you shadow logs for the first 15m? i can post quick grep commands.
sam: yep, i'll tail api logs and kv cache logs. command i use: `stern api -n redwood --since 15m | grep enable_new_defaults`
ops-bot: Scheduled toggle-ops check at 11:30 PT. Reminder in 15 minutes.
maria: timeline: 11:30 flip -> 11:30-12:00 low-risk only -> 12:00 expand to 25% traffic -> hold 30m -> full at 13:00 if stable. anyone object?
chris: sounds good. small ask — can we set safe-defaults flag to true for any unknown models during rollout? so unknown model paths keep old behavior.
maria: good call. i'll bundle `safe_unknown_model_defaults=true` in the same config change. that keeps behavior conservative.
devon: smoke results: all health checks green, p95 stable, no 5xx spike in first 5m. sampling customers A/B showed consistent outputs.
sam: logs look clean. one noisy warning on kv-prefetch but not tied to the flag. i'll open a follow-up ticket if it repeats.
maria: expanding to 25% now. keeping live notes: https://docs.redwood.dev/ops/enable_new_defaults/notes-1738502468
chris: pinged QA for spot-check on a few edge prompts. also leaving a CR note about the feature gate comment.
ops-bot: Alert rule: latency-p95 crossed 1.5x baseline — ok to ignore if transient?
maria: saw that — it was transient and recovered within the 2-min window. continuing.
devon: rolling forward to full at 13:00 unless someone yells stop before 12:45. i won't be on-call after 12:50.
sam: if anything, i can kick rollback after 12:50. maria — confirm handover?
maria: confirmed — if anything weird after 12:50, ping #eng-oncall and i'll trigger rollback. otherwise i'll finish the full rollout. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
